info.title: Automa Core API
info.description: High-performance Rust backend daemon providing REST, SSE, and storage APIs for the Automa automation ecosystem.

get.description: Retrieves an array of all persisted browser profiles, including their active online/offline connection state.

post.description: Persists a new isolated browser profile with custom fingerprint settings (User-Agent, Timezone) in SQLite.

400.description: Invalid browser ID or missing name

500.description: Failed to create browser profile in database

post.summary: Batch import browser profiles from CSV
post.description: Parses a multi-line CSV string and batch inserts new browser profiles into SQLite.

200.description: CSV profiles successfully parsed and imported

delete.description: Forcefully shuts down all managed browser processes, child workers, and zombie processes across all profiles.

get.description: Retrieves full configuration details and live online status for a specific browser profile.

put.description: Updates the configuration and metadata of an existing browser profile by ID.

delete.description: Permanently removes a browser profile from SQLite storage and cleans up associated session data.

get.summary: Export cookies for a browser profile
get.description: Extracts and decrypts all network cookies stored in the browser profile's Chromium SQLite cookie database.

500.description: Failed to access or decrypt cookie store

post.summary: Import cookies into a browser profile
post.description: Batch writes and encrypts an array of cookies directly into the browser profile's Chromium SQLite cookie database.

500.description: Failed to write cookies to database

post.summary: Sideload unpacked extension into browser profile
post.description: Copies and configures an external unpacked extension into the specified browser profile's data directory.
Launches an actual browser process (Chromium/Chrome) assigned to the specified profile, loads the Automa extension runner, and positions the window according to the active grid matrix.

delete.description: Gracefully closes the running browser process associated with the profile ID, cleans up temporary locks, and streams teardown progress via SSE.

post.description: Parses a campaign descriptor, provisions required browser profiles, allocates grid matrix slots, and starts parallel workflow execution jobs.

400.description: Invalid campaign payload or unreadable descriptor

delete.description: Immediately halts all sub-jobs associated with the campaign, stops all browser processes in the grid matrix, and emits a matrix_finished SSE event.

get.summary: Get campaign grid matrix execution status
get.description: Retrieves real-time slot layout and execution status for a multi-instance grid campaign.

get.summary: Subscribe to global telemetry and logs SSE stream
get.description: Establishes a real-time Server-Sent Events stream for task progression, job lifecycle changes, logs, and matrix events.

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream for task logs and progress

get.description: Returns active operational health status, daemon version, and server readiness for clients.

200.description: Daemon is healthy and accepting requests

get.description: Queries previous workflow execution runs and audit logs persisted in the SQLite database.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of history entries to return (default 50)

200.description: List of past job execution summaries

delete.description: Permanently truncates the job execution history and purge all logs from the database.

delete.summary: Delete a single job history item
delete.description: Removes a specific job run and its associated logs from the SQLite history store.

get.summary: Get execution details and logs for a job
get.description: Retrieves full execution audit trail, timing breakdown, and detailed step logs for a specific job.

200.description: Detailed job execution record and logs

get.description: Establishes a long-lived Server-Sent Events (SSE) connection used by browser workers to receive workflow job dispatches and cancellation commands.
Returns an array of identifiers for all workflow execution jobs currently running in the daemon.

post.description: Submits a new automation workflow job to be executed by a browser worker instance. Supports either a filesystem `workflowPath` or raw inline `workflowData`. Automatically ensures the required browser instance is launched and connected.

200.description: Job submitted and accepted for execution

400.description: Invalid request payload or unreadable workflow file

503.description: Browser worker unavailable or connection timeout

delete.description: Immediately triggers the cancellation token for the specified job, sends a stop signal to the browser worker, and updates job state.

404.description: Job not found or not active

post.summary: Append execution log entry for a job
post.description: Receives runtime log entries and block execution telemetry from the browser worker, persisting them to the database and broadcasting via SSE.

200.description: Log entry received and persisted successfully

400.description: Invalid payload or job not found

get.summary: Get current status of a job
get.description: Queries the runtime lifecycle status of a specific job by its unique identifier.

patch.description: Signals the completion of a workflow execution job, records the final status in SQLite, releases active tokens, and notifies subscribers.

404.description: Job not found or already finished

post.summary: Validate and lint workflow AST graph
post.description: Performs static analysis on workflow nodes, edge connections, parameter schemas, and detects structural defects.

post.summary: Encrypt sensitive token or secret with AES-256
post.description: Encrypts plaintext secrets using PBKDF2 and AES-GCM-256 authenticated encryption.

get.description: Retrieves all saved authentication credentials from storage.

post.summary: Add or update a stored credential
post.description: Persists a new credential or updates an existing credential in storage.

delete.description: Permanently removes a credential from storage by ID or key.

get.summary: List all workflow and campaign files in storage workspace
get.description: Recursively traverses the `automa-vault` storage directory and returns metadata for all `.workflow.json` and `.campaign.json` files.

200.description: List all workflow and campaign files in storage

get.description: Retrieves schemas for all user data tables stored in SQLite.

post.summary: Create or update a storage table schema
post.description: Defines a new data table schema or modifies column definitions for an existing table.

delete.description: Drops the specified data table and purges all of its associated rows from SQLite.

get.summary: Get rows from a storage table
get.description: Queries paginated row documents belonging to the specified data table.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 50)

post.summary: Insert a row into a storage table
post.description: Appends a new document row into the specified data table.

get.description: Retrieves all global and local variables persisted in Automa SQLite storage.

post.summary: Add or update a storage variable
post.description: Creates a new variable or updates an existing variable by ID/key in storage.

delete.description: Permanently removes a variable from storage by ID or key.

get.summary: Read workflow JSON file from filesystem
get.description: Reads and parses an automation workflow file (.workflow.json) from the given filesystem path.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Full filesystem path to the target .workflow.json file

400.description: Invalid path or unreadable workflow JSON

404.description: Workflow file not found on disk

put.summary: Save or update workflow JSON file
put.description: Serializes and writes the workflow content to the specified path on disk, creating parent directories automatically if needed.

post.description: Downloads and extracts the latest compatible Chromium build into the local cache via `@puppeteer/browsers`.

200.description: Chromium binary downloaded and installed successfully

get.description: Samples current CPU load, memory utilization, and active browser runner counts.

get.summary: Get current application and grid settings
get.description: Retrieves current daemon configuration including Grid Matrix layout, default browser preferences, and Runner concurrency settings.

put.description: Replaces the entire application configuration and persists new grid, browser, and runner settings.

patch.description: Selectively updates specific sections of settings (e.g. grid matrix rows/columns or browser default type) without overwriting other properties.

post.summary: Open Web Studio in default system browser
post.description: Spawns the default OS web browser and navigates to the locally served Automa Web Studio canvas editor.

200.description: Web Studio opened successfully in system browser

allOf.description: Dynamic column values for the row

AddTableRowPayload.description: Key-value payload for inserting a new table row

AddTableRowResponse.description: Response returned after appending a row to a storage table

isOnline.description: Whether an active browser process is currently connected

CreateBrowserRequest.description: Request payload for creating a new browser profile

id.description: Optional custom ID (auto-generated UUID if omitted)

EncryptSecretRequest.description: Request payload to encrypt a secret string

passphrase.description: Optional encryption master passphrase (falls back to AUTOMA_PASSPHRASE env)

ExecuteCampaignRequest.description: Request payload to trigger or schedule a campaign execution

useGrid.description: Automatically tile browser windows across screen grid

ExecuteCampaignResponse.description: Response returned after scheduling a campaign

version.description: Semantic version of the running daemon binary

HistoryActionResponse.description: Response returned after performing a history modification or purge action

ImportCsvPayload.description: Request payload containing raw CSV formatted browser profiles

csv_string.description: Raw CSV string containing profile headers and rows

ImportCsvResponse.description: Response after batch importing browser profiles from CSV

JobLogPayload.description: Payload containing execution logs and telemetry emitted by a workflow step

logs.description: Array of structured log entries or node execution telemetry

JobStatusResponse.description: Current execution status of a background job

LintIssue.description: Diagnostic issue report detected by the workflow linter

path.description: JSONPath location of the affected element

LintRequest.description: Request payload to lint workflow AST nodes and edges

edges.description: Array of workflow edge connection descriptors

nodes.description: Array of workflow block node definitions

LintResponse.description: Result of workflow AST validation and lint checks

issues.description: List of detected validation warnings and errors

valid.description: Whether the workflow passed validation without errors

MatrixSlotInfo.description: Display bounds and runtime state for a grid window slot

MatrixStatusResponse.description: Grid matrix telemetry and slot allocation for a campaign

totalTasks.description: Total tasks queued in the campaign

SaveWorkflowPayload.description: Request payload for saving or updating a workflow file

content.description: Workflow JSON content object (nodes, edges, settings)

path.description: Target filesystem path where the workflow should be written

SaveWorkflowResponse.description: Response returned after saving a workflow file

success.description: Whether the file was written successfully

SideloadExtensionPayload.description: Payload containing filesystem path to an unpacked browser extension

extension_path.description: Full filesystem path to the unpacked extension directory (containing manifest.json)

SideloadExtensionResponse.description: Response after sideloading an extension into a browser profile

StorageFileInfo.description: File descriptor for a workflow or campaign in the storage vault

path.description: Full absolute path on the filesystem

relativePath.description: Path relative to the storage vault root

StorageTable.description: User data table schema in Automa storage

StorageVariable.description: Global variable stored in Automa SQLite / FS storage

key.description: Unique variable key used in workflow expressions

value.description: Arbitrary JSON value or primitive stored

SubmitJobOptions.description: Advanced runtime execution options for a workflow job

closeBrowserOnFinish.description: Automatically close browser session when workflow execution finishes

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging and DevTools inspection

headless.description: Run browser in headless mode (no visible window)

variables.description: Dynamic variables to inject into the workflow execution scope

SubmitJobPayload.description: Request payload for submitting a new workflow execution job

oneOf.description: Optional execution options and browser configuration

workflowData.description: Raw inline workflow JSON payload (alternative to workflowPath)

workflowPath.description: Absolute or relative filesystem path to the `.workflow.json` file

SubmitJobResponse.description: Response returned after successfully submitting a workflow job

jobId.description: Unique identifier of the created execution job

SystemMetricsResponse.description: Real-time CPU, RAM, and browser runner metrics

activeRunners.description: Number of actively connected browser runner instances

memoryTotal.description: Total system physical memory in bytes

TableRow.description: Single data row entry belonging to a storage table

data.description: Key-value document payload of row columns

UpdateBrowserRequest.description: Request payload for modifying an existing browser profile
